subject: Member number and number of members
author: Xandu
body:
Your member number does not reflect how many members the site had when you signed up. We have quite a few people signing up without activating their account. These accounts get auto deleted after 7 days. That is why the member numbers are higher than the actual number of members.

We actually have 712 members now so making it 840 by xmas shouldn't be too hard. Maybe we should try and make it to 1000 instead? 🙂

-- The Creator --
